4. Off-cut reuse

Off-cuts are numbered OC-item.no, for example OC-2.1 is off-cut 1 of item 2. Leftover strips and unused parts of blocks can be cut into pieces of other items.

5. Shipping

Shipping is off. Switch on Calculate shipping to work out the trucks needed and add the shipping cost to each item.
Reset clears the inputs only. Saved tasks, the store and the consumption log are never changed.
